result.topic_en: Gauss defines theta-type series (a,m)=Σe^{-a(k+m)^2}, states a general product theorem for them, and uses it to compute a differential expression a dm in terms of these series, reducing it to products of theta values.
result.transcription:
Math 25 \quad (70) \quad 47d/19
$(a,m)=\Sigma e^{-a(k+m)^2}$ \quad k, alle ganzen Zahlen
General-Lehrsatz.
1) $(a,m)(a,n) = (2a,\tfrac12(m+n))(2a,\tfrac12(m-n)) + (2a,\tfrac12(m+n+1))(2a,\tfrac12(m-n+1))$
Es soll bewiesen werden
2) $a\,dm = \dfrac{(a,m)\,d(a,m+\tfrac12) - (a,m+\tfrac12)\,d(a,m)}{\sqrt{\{(a,0)^2(a,m)^2 - (a,\tfrac12)^2(a,m+\tfrac12)^2\}}\cdot\sqrt{\{(a,\tfrac12)^2(a,m)^2 + (a,0)^2(a,m+\tfrac12)^2\}}}$
Zuvörderst verwandelt sich der Zähler von 2 in
$(a,m)(a,m+\partial m+\tfrac12) - (a,m+\tfrac12)(a,m+\partial m)$
woraus mit Hülfe von 1 sich ergibt
$a\{(2a,m-\tfrac14)-(2a,m+\tfrac14)\}\cdot\{e^{-\frac18 a} - 3e^{-\frac98 a} + 5e^{-\frac{25}{8}a} - 7e^{-\frac{49}{8}a} + \text{etc.}\}\cdot\partial m$
$= aL\,dm$
Es ist aber
$e^{-\frac18 a} - 3e^{-\frac98 a} + 5e^{-\frac{25}{8}a} - 7e^{-\frac{49}{8}a} + \text{etc.} = \tfrac12(\tfrac12 a,\tfrac12)(1-2e^{-a}+2e^{-4a}-2e^{-9a}\ldots)^2$
$= \tfrac12(\tfrac12 a,\tfrac12)\{(a,0)^2-(a,\tfrac12)^2\}^2$ [?]
ferner
$\{(2a,m-\tfrac14)-(2a,m+\tfrac14)\}^2 = (a,0)(a,2m+\tfrac12) - (a,\tfrac12)(a,2m)$
$(e^{-\frac18 a} - 3e^{-\frac98 a} + 5e^{-\frac{25}{8}a} - )^2 = \tfrac12(a,0)(a,\tfrac12)(1-2e^{-a}+2e^{-4a}-)^4$
also $LL = (1-2e^{-a}+2e^{-4a}-2e^{-9a}+-)^4\{(a,0)^2(2a,m+\tfrac12)(2a,m) - \tfrac12(a,\tfrac12)^2\{(2a,m)^2+(2a,m+\tfrac12)^2\}\}$
Da $(a,m)^2 = (2a,0)(2a,m) + (2a,\tfrac12)(2a,m+\tfrac12)$
$(a,m+\tfrac12)^2 = (2a,\tfrac12)(2a,m) + (2a,0)(2a,m+\tfrac12)$ \quad also
$\{(2a,0)^2-(2a,\tfrac12)^2\}(2a,m) = (2a,0)(a,m)^2 - (2a,\tfrac12)(a,m+\tfrac12)^2 = pP^2 - rR^2$
$\{(2a,0)^2-(2a,\tfrac12)^2\}(2a,m+\tfrac12) = -(2a,\tfrac12)(a,m)^2 + (2a,0)(a,m+\tfrac12)^2 = -rP^2 + pR^2$
$(2a,0)^2-(2a,\tfrac12)^2 = (1-2e^{-a}+2e^{-4a}\ldots)^2$ so wird
$LL = (a,0)^2\{(pp+rr)PPRR - pr(P^4+R^4)\} - \tfrac12(a,\tfrac12)^2\{(pp+rr)(P^4+R^4) - 4pr\,PPRR\}$
Da ferner $pp+rr=(a,0)^2$, $2pr=(a,\tfrac12)^2$

methods.what: Definition of theta-type series summed over all integers
General product (addition) theorem for theta series
Differential relation expressing a dm via theta quotients
Series identity for the derivative-type theta series (Jacobi-type triple product)
Square of difference of theta values expressed via products
Duplication formulas for squares of theta functions
Inversion of duplication formulas with p, r, P, R notation
Expression for LL in terms of p, r, P, R
